sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold-Plated Adjustable AD Knot Design Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Make a bold yet elegant statement with this gold-plated adjustable knot ring, embellished with dazzling American Diamond stones. Its chic knot design symbolizes love and togetherness, making it perfect for daily wear, parties, or gifting.
- Material: Brass base
- Plating: Premium Gold-plated finish
- Stone Type: Sparkling American Diamond (AD)
- Design: Knot-style band with studded stones
- Size & Fit: Adjustable – fits most finger sizes
- Style & Use: Suitable for daily wear, party looks, and gifting
